correctness.rationale: A backbite reverses an even-size prefix/suffix up to a graph-neighbor endpoint, represented by involutions P_j and S_j on alternating X/Y permutations. For K_n,n, conjugates P_j P_2 P_j and S_j S_2 S_j give pure adjacent X/Y swaps at ≤3 backbites each, yielding diameter ≤6n(n−1). For K_n,n+1, pure Y adjacent swaps have cost ≤3, P3 or S3 combined with their correction gives pure X swaps ≤12, establishing diameter ≤15n²−9n. Exhaustive independently built undirected path-backbite graphs: K1,2 one state; K2,2 four states diameter2; K2,3 six states diameter3; K3,3 36 states diameter4; K3,4 72 states diameter6. These corroborate, not prove, all-n macros. All traceable complete bipartite cases covered.
